about: Live vs final dictation transcript and the live cleanup, 34 of Robin's Mac dictations (German, 16 min) replayed in a test app on an M1 Pro, 25-26 Nov 2026. Numbers only; ids are recording file names. Edits are word-level edit distances after lower-casing and removing punctuation and fillers. See docs/research/live-vs-final-2026-11.md.
